description:
Top 3 skills are Struts, EJB, and OO. 
 Looking for end to end developers.
 Struts, EJB, and Web Services are a must. If candidate has Hibernate and not EJB, that is ok too. 

 Hands on, go-getter etc. Needs to fit into ETCC’s culture
 Top Three Skills: 

 2-5 YRS Struts, Spring/Hibernate, web services
 Job Description: 
 Mid to sr level java developer with 2-5+ years of overall experience but STRUTS, JSP, EJB 3.0, Web Services are the major skill sets needed. A candidate with Hibernate experience will also be considered in lieu of EJB 3.
 2-5 years of experience in system analysis, design,
 and implementation of web-based applications. Demonstrates hands-on experience in full development life  cycle of enterprise scaled software applications utilizing Oracle object oriented analysis, design, and  implementation of web-based applications. Demonstrates expertise in JSP, Java Servlet, Struts,EJB3 Experience  with Weblogic application server is a plus. 
 Additional Information: 
 Working knowledge EJB, PL/SQL and JMS is a plus as well.
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 months contract to hire 
 Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.  

 
 Candidate need to be local and can interview face to face.
years_evidence: Mid to sr level java developer with 2-5+ years of overall experience but STRUTS, JSP, EJB 3.
